business_problem: XPAI needed a privacy-preserving way to measure how people use and perceive physical spaces so brands and event operators could optimize offline experiences with real-time evidence instead of intuition.
solution_summary: XPAI built an edge-based measurement stack for physical spaces so brands and event teams could understand how visitors use and perceive offline experiences without exporting personally identifiable data. AVAI One Sensor captures millions of data points per second from rooms and installations, while a Jetson Orin-powered processing engine uses the DeepStream SDK and TensorRT to refine visitor data in real time. XPAI AI analyzes perception and engagement signals, and the XPAI Heartbeat analytics layer turns them into live dashboards and feedback loops. Because the platform establishes a baseline for each environment and returns results instantly, operators can run A/B tests on music, lighting, or product placement and see how audiences respond while the experience is still underway. A GDPR-compliant architecture keeps only anonymized data leaving the system.

solution_components.name: AVAI One Sensor
solution_components.role: Captures physical-space signals and raw audience data for the measurement platform.

solution_components.name: XPAI AI
solution_components.role: Processes engagement and perception data so operators can understand how audiences respond to physical experiences.

solution_components.name: XPAI Heartbeat

solution_components.name: NVIDIA DeepStream SDK
solution_components.role: Accelerates the processing pipeline for large streams of visitor and environment data.
